children: Curanex Pharmaceuticals regained Nasdaq compliance after a 1-for-20 reverse stock split that restored its $1.00 minimum bid price.
Nasdaq notified Curanex Pharmaceuticals on Nov 5, 2025 it failed to maintain $1.00 minimum bid under Rule 5550(a)(2).
Company effected a 1-for-20 reverse stock split on Aug 20, 2026 to cure the deficiency.
From Aug 20 to Sep 2, 2026 the stock closed at $1.00 or greater for 10 consecutive business days.
Nasdaq informed the company on Sep 3, 2026 that it has regained compliance and the matter is closed.
